name: Electric science factory · 30/min each
setupNotes: Feed iron ore, copper ore, coal, stone, water and crude oil at the six labeled input ports.
Each of the four science output chests is beside the outer end of its science block on a short local belt.
Match each input display to its nearby entrance. Connect from the indicated side; both belt lanes accept the shown raw material. Alt shows the labels.
All smelting uses electric furnaces and electricity is external; no solid-fuel plant or furnace fuel route is included.
Fast transport belts, fast underground belts and fast splitters are used; no robots, modules, beacons or quality are included.
Connect the labeled raw inputs near their processing blocks. Science leaves at local north/south chests. Intermediate routes end after their last consumer.
Intermediate assemblers use a shared circuit clock to limit excess production during startup.
changes: Finished science leaves from local north/south chests; the four science output buses are removed.
Raw inputs are near their processing blocks, and shared routes terminate at their last consumer.
Three-ingredient rows use three-tile machine spacing, filtered result extraction and lane guides; adjacent crossings share longer underground pairs.
One extra logistic-science assembler provides recovery capacity within the existing footprint; production controls keep science near the balanced target.

section: Four science packs from raw materials

notes: Inputs are recipe ingredients and recognized machine fuels or fluids supplied from outside. Outputs are products not consumed by another included process. Check belt, pipe, and robot connections in-game; this analysis does not simulate routing or throughput.
43 furnaces/recyclers have labeled processing feeds in this layout. The analysis includes those recipes; the machines select their actual recipe from the supplied ingredient.

validation.note: Passed 45 simulated minutes in Factorio 2.0.77 from an empty start with only the six labeled raw inputs and external electricity. All four outputs refilled after collection. Every furnace ran on external electricity. All machines and inserters were connected to P.

benchmark.rateBasis: Input rates are deltas from LuaForce item/fluid production statistics output_counts/get_output_count at the warmup boundary and final tick. They report recipe and burner-fuel consumption rather than exterior belt acceptance; output rates are continuously collected after warmup.
